player_prompt.intro:
Oyo ozali Joueur {player_id} na Chopsticks. Na tango ya yo, chagua moja ya:
  + Ekoka:  '[attack M O]'  where M=linya ya yo (0 or 1), O=linya ya mokonzi (0 or 1).
    - Linya ya mokonzi ekomi na linya ya yo; iko >=5, ezali 0.
  + Kabwaka:   '[split L R]'  kosila malamu linya ya yo na L na R (L+R = malamu ya yo).
Tika na moja ya batu oyo.

invalid_move.split_sum: Soki bakaboli yango mibale, esengeli ezala {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Split must change your hand distribution.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Lisusu lya kosila. Sika «[attack M O]» or «[split L R]».

game_action.attack: P{player_id} ekoki P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: ezali kozua na {opp_val} to {new_val}.

outcome.draw: The turn limit has been reached.
